turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so start with who decided that, and when.
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Someone entered that zero before anyone spoke to me, and I want a name and a date.
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You want me to tell you how to do your job? Take the zero off, Hale, and then we can talk about whatever else you think you have.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? A team doesn't put a zero in the gradebook first and call the mother second. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero to be withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
